evidence.source: FINDINGS §33.5 (oracle gate: true metrics as predictions)

evidence.quote: **Between 78% and 90% of every ngspice call this pipeline has ever spent inside ZOAF was, in hindsight, unnecessary** — the point never beat the incumbent and never would have. That is a property of the *search*, not of any model, and it is the size of the prize a surrogate pre-gate is playing for.
"82.6% skippable" is a property of ZOAF's trajectory that no model was needed to measure, and reporting it first is what keeps "62.8% skipped" from reading as a model result.

rule: Run the gate with the true metrics as predictions and report that oracle skip rate before quoting any surrogate number.

applicability.applies: Any pre-gate, filter or acquisition function. The immediate measured lever here is gating size_best_of_k's seeds 2 and 3 -- a warm-start case the pipeline manufactures every night, where v0 preserves 11/11 argmins while skipping 42.9%.
applicability.not: Nothing may land on surrogate evidence alone: every accepted point is verified with the real harness. The gate is MARGIN-limited by the surrogate's own point error (cold start needs Delta=5 to be safe, warm start Delta=2), so the savings curve moves with data, not with architecture. And v0's numbers are pre-cutover-era only.
